newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH FOOD TRADE DEFICIT UP 18.3 PCT IN JAN-MAY.
newsitem.headline: POLISH FOOD TRADE DEFICIT UP 18.3 PCT IN JAN-MAY.

text.p: Polish food exports increased 17.1 percent to $1.23 billion in the January-May period while imports rose 17.5 percent to $1.82 billion, the Rzeczpospolita daily said on Friday.
The food trade defiict in the five-month period, at $588 million, as 18.3 percent higher than in the same time of 1996.
The European Union accounted for 47.8 percent of Polish imports and 39.0 percent of exports. The former Soviet states made up 42.7 percent of Polish food exports.
